title: Product worked as described. But waste of money for me.
text: Product worked as described. But waste of money for me.. Product worked as described, but I only used it twice.  I can skip the remove water and squish step and the ways I cook tofu, it doesn't make much of a difference in food taste or texture. I guess I'm too ADHD for this step.
